name: Iris Prize for Nature (Iris, Stem and Seed Prizes)
summary: Annual prizes of $5,000 to $15,000 for youth-led projects (leaders aged 14 to 24) that protect or restore nature, mainly in the Global South, with mentoring and other support alongside the money.

status.quote: The Iris Prize 2027 will open in March.

applicant_types.quote: Your project or organisation is led by young people aged 14 to 24.

geography.quote: We prioritise initiatives in the Global South, where our support can have a more significant impact. But we also consider exceptional projects from the Global North.

access.quote: March 1st at 11:00 CET Open call The Iris Prize 2027 will open.

window.quote: March 1st at 11:00 CET Open call The Iris Prize 2027 will open.

amount.quote: The Iris Prize $15,000 Awarded to an established project with the potential to replicate and scale. Ages 16-24 The Stem Prize $10,000 Awarded to an existing project established recently and on a small scale. Ages 16-24 The Seed Prize $5,000
